product_metadata.title: JOERSH 6 Pack Fondant Impression Mat Wood Fondant Mold Set, Embossed Tree Bark/Brick Wall/Flower/Cobblestone/Stone Wall Texture Design Mold for Chocolate Cupcake Topper Wedding Cake
features: PACKAGE - Includes 6 pieces fondant molds for cake decorations,each mold measures 5.75" L X 2.7" W, good idea for small decor like edging, wraps, and statement pieces of fondant and icing
CLASSIC PATTERNS - 6 patterns fondant tools ,they are tree bark, brick wall, cobblestone, stone wall, mayan sun, flower vine lace
SMOOTH FLEXIBLE PLASTIC - Impression molds are embossed and textured to give your cakes and home made bakes a unique design

EASY TO USE - Roll out your dough or icing ready for placing on your cakes; Place the mould on top, textured side down and roll over with a little sugar using a rolling pin for the pattern to be imprinted; Repeat for larger pieces or alternate between the 2 designs

NON-STICK - This cake decorating supplies set in our set feature non stick technology, this feature makes the mats EASY TO WASH; simply hand wash or pop on the top shelf of your dishwasher for cleaning
